headline: Ford pledges not to sell driving data to brokers in new privacy push
summary: Ford launched a new 'privacy promise' committing never to sell customers' driving data to third-party data brokers, which it frames as setting it apart from rivals that faced legal and regulatory blowback over telematics data sharing. Both outlets describe the same commitment without disagreement.
